purpose: Establish a native metric framework for RT Relational Mechanics and Constraint Geometry prior to physical projection metrics.

W_a.name: Admissibility Weight
W_a.description: Measures robustness of legality rather than binary legal/illegal status.

C_s.name: Closure Stability
C_s.description: Measures persistence of closure under perturbation.

rho_D.name: Distinction Density
rho_D.description: Measures distinguishable relational structure per evaluation region.

N_R.name: Novel Relation Generation
N_R.description: Measures emergence of new lawful relations not already present in input blocks.

T_RQ.name: RT-QM Edge Tension
T_RQ.description: Measures compatibility pressure between RT and QM_app.

T_RG.name: RT-GR Edge Tension
T_RG.description: Measures compatibility pressure between RT and GR_app.

T_QG.name: QM-GR Edge Tension
T_QG.description: Measures compatibility pressure between QM_app and GR_app.

C_triangle.name: Triangle Closure Stability
C_triangle.description: Measures persistence of the full triadic closure under perturbation.

S_triangle.name: Triadic Symmetry
S_triangle.description: Measures contribution balance among RT, QM_app, and GR_app.

P_B.name: Basin Persistence Probability
P_B.description: Probability that a closure basin persists through update cycles.

P_R.name: Reformation Probability
P_R.description: Probability that a collapsed structure reforms.

H_C.name: Constraint Entropy
H_C.description: Measures uncertainty in admissible continuation pathways.
